item.objective: Add a version-pinned UTS #39 confusable-skeleton audit for object-key ambiguity without mutating signed or canonicalized data.
completed_slices: Researched Unicode Technical Standard #39 version 17.0.0 and the current Unicode confusables data header.
Implemented a parser that requires and optionally pins the data version and retains the exact source SHA-256.
Implemented NFD-based skeleton construction and sibling-key collision detection with escaped object paths.
Added fail-closed enforcement while preserving the original object unchanged.
Verified four deterministic Node tests using representative Latin/Cyrillic and Latin/Greek fixture mappings.
acceptance_remaining: Pin and retain the complete Unicode 17.0.0 confusables.txt bytes or an independently verified digest in the execution environment.
Run the implementation against the complete official dataset and retain exact output.
Define the repository ecosystem policy for reject, quarantine, or advisory treatment of confusable key collisions.
Add separate script-restriction and Identifier_Status layers if the artifact namespace accepts human-authored Unicode identifiers.
item.safe_next_action: Fetch the exact Unicode 17.0.0 confusables.txt bytes, verify and retain their digest, run the committed tests plus full-data smoke cases, then integrate this audit after strict parse and cryptographic verification but before semantic acceptance.
